title: The Cosmic Cycle of Creation: Maha Vishnu, Garbhodakshaayi Vishnu, and Ksheerodakshaayi Vishnu
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: To understand the vastness of the cosmos described in Vedic traditions, one must be willing to set aside ordinary notions of time and space. What we call a universe, immense beyond measure, is revealed as but one of countless such creations. And what we call history, stretching back thousands of years, is but a fleeting moment in a grand, cyclical drama that has been unfolding eternally.In this vision, life and matter do not simply appear at random.
